note: Beginner-facing explainers for notable card traits, surfaced as tappable pills under the type line. Keyed by trait id. Detection lives in CardTraits.swift (name prefix / reserved flag / Scryfall layout); this file holds the display text. tint is a colour name mapped in CardTraits.swift. Definitions are original paraphrases (game rules aren't copyrightable). Add a trait by adding an entry here plus one detection line in CardTraits.swift.

alchemy.label: Alchemy
alchemy.definition: A rebalanced, digital-only version of a card made for Magic: The Gathering Arena's Alchemy format. Its stats or text have been tuned for digital play, so it differs from the paper card and can't be used in tabletop formats.

reserved.label: Reserved List
reserved.definition: This card is on Wizards of the Coast's Reserved List — a long-standing promise never to reprint it. That guaranteed scarcity often makes original printings sought-after and valuable.

double_faced.label: Double-Faced
double_faced.definition: A card with two faces. It enters on its front face and can transform to the back — or, for modal double-faced cards, be cast as either side. Use the flip control to view each face.

split.label: Split Card
split.definition: Two separate spells printed on one card. You may cast either half, each with its own cost and effect; some split cards let you cast both halves together.

adventure.label: Adventure
adventure.definition: A creature that also carries an Adventure spell. You may cast the Adventure first for its effect and exile the card, then cast the creature later from exile — or just cast the creature normally.

flip.label: Flip Card
flip.definition: An older two-in-one card. A listed condition flips it 180 degrees to its other half, which has its own name, stats and abilities.

saga.label: Saga
saga.definition: An enchantment that tells a story. It gains a lore counter as it enters and on each of your draw steps, triggering its chapter abilities in order, then is sacrificed after the final chapter.

class.label: Class
class.definition: An enchantment you can level up. Pay its level cost any time you could cast a sorcery to advance to the next level and unlock stronger abilities.
